limitations: No query-level held-out examples or raw model outputs published.
No multiplicity adjustment; confidence intervals alone do not prove all comparisons significant.
Independent semantic/factual review remains necessary before strong claims.
The separately verified seed-42 candidate-stage replacement does not reconstruct the original indeterminate model call.

method.asr: targeted success out of the full frozen query population, with construction failures retained as failures
method.atr: final source AND target targeted successes divided by final source targeted successes; undefined if denominator zero
method.ci95: 2000 query-cluster bootstrap replicates retaining all poison seeds; unadjusted for multiplicity
method.semantic_validation_note: Automated construction acceptance does not prove fabricated evidence is factually valid.

study.source_selection: fixed candidate library; source-only feedback before all target evaluations
study.target_barrier: selected poison instances globally sealed before target evaluation
